translation.name: Dižaʼ chaweʼ kub len Salmo kaʼ

book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: DIŽA' DA' ẔZEJNI'ILEN BENÁCH HEBREO KA'

content: Jesús nake' Bx̱oz Blo kan gok Melkisedek

Melkisedek goke' benne' wnná bi'e ḻo yež Salem, na' ḻezka' goke' bx̱oz che Dios, Bennen' ẕente. Kate' ne zezá' Bran, zeyeje' wdé gok wdiḻe katen' blej bchochje' benne' wnná bia' ka', na' bžoj Melkisedek na', na' bejchage' Bran na', na' wnnable' Dios gon chawe'e Bran na'.

Bran na' bneẕjwe' Melkisedek na' to kwe' che to chi kwe' che yógo'te da' wẕi'e ḻo wdiḻen'. Da' zejḻás la Melkisedek na' ẕnnan ḻen diža' x̱iža': “Benne' Wnná Bia' Chawe'” na' ḻezka' nake' benne' ẕnna bi'e ḻo yež Salem, da' ẕnnan ḻen diža' x̱iža': “Benne' Wnná Bia' Ẕka'n Žie'.”
Bi nyejw ḻe'e yiche da' ẕnnan wnníta'gak x̱a x̱ne'e, o x̱a x̱ta'we' ka', na' bi nyejw ža golje' o ža gote', san nake' kan nak Ẕi'n Dios dan' nake' to chi'ize bx̱oz blo.
Le wia nga, kan gok Melkisedek na' ẕen, dan' x̱ažo Bran na'kze bneẕjwe' chie' to kwe' che to chi kwe' che da' wlejen' ḻo na'gak benne' wnná bia' ka', benne' ka' blej bchochje' ḻo wdiḻen'.

Ḻo da' bzoj Moisés, Dios wnné' benne' ka' zej nake' ẕa'só Lebí, benne' ka' zej nake' bx̱oz ka', sí'gake' to kwe' che to chi kwe' che da' ẕzi'gak benách Israel ka', ḻa'kze zej nake' ljéžgake' ka', dan' yógo'tegake' zej nake' ẕa'só Bran na'.
Melkisedek na' bi nake' ljéžgake', san wẕi'e to kwe' che to chi kwe' ḻo na' Bran na', bennen' wẕi'e da' ka' bchebe ḻaže' Dios wneẕjwe' chie'. Ḻezka' Melkisedek na' wnnable' Dios gon chawe'e Bran na',
na' bi gak nitó benne' wži'e che da' ẕnnan: “Bennen' nakže' blo ḻaw Dios ẕnnable' Dios gon chawe'e bennen' nakže' gax̱jw.”
Na'a, ža ni zoažo na'a, benne' ka' ẕzí'gake' to kwe' che to chi kwe' ḻo na'gak benách ka' ḻezka' zej nake' benách žátgakkze', san Melkisedek na', zoa da' ẕnnan kan nak chie', da' ẕnnan zoe' nbane'.

Na'a, gak nnažo kan nak che Lebí, na' chegak ẕa'sóe' ka', benne' ka' ẕzí'gake' to kwe' che to chi kwe' ḻo na'gak benách ka', ḻezka' wdíẕjwgake' to kwe' che to chi kwe' katen' Melkisedek na' wẕi'e to kwe' che to chi kwe' ḻo na' Bran na', x̱a gole wdé chégake'.
Ki naken dan' gak nnažo Bran na' ne noe'e Lebín', na' ẕa'sóe' ka' ḻi'e katen' Melkisedek na' bejchage' ḻe', dan' bi na' gáḻjgake'.

Benách Israel ka' ẕzí'gake' x̱tiža' Moisés ḻo na'gak bx̱oz ka', benne' ka' zej nake' ẕa'só Lebín', gan ḻezka' nbab Aarón, bennen' goke' bx̱oz blo nežw. Na'a, chela' gak yeyakgak benách ka' dot chawe' ḻaw Dios dan' žóngake' kan ẕnna da' bchi'le Moisés na', bi gon byenen soa yetó bx̱oz kan gok Melkisedek na', na' kege kan gok Aarón na'.
Cha' bcha' Dios kan žaḻa' gak bx̱oz, na' žon byenen wché'e da' ẕchi'le' benách ka'.
X̱anžon', Bennen' nyejw ḻe'e yiche da' ki kan nak chie', nbabe' yetó kwe' ẕa'só Israel ka naken da' nbab Lebín', na' che kwe' ẕa'só ka' gan nbab X̱anžon', nitó benne' goke' bx̱oz ḻaw Dios.
Naken ki dan' nak bia' golj X̱anžon' ḻo kwe' ljež ka' Judá, na' Moisés na' bi bchaḻje' che Judá na' katen' bchaḻje' chegak benne' ka' žaḻa' gákgake' bx̱oz ka'.
Nak bia' da' ni ni'a che da' žaken na'a. Kan gok Melkisedek na' bx̱oz, ba bḻoe'e ḻaw yetó Bx̱oz, Jesusen'.
Benne' ni, bi nake' Bx̱oz dan' ẕnna da' bsedle Moisés na' kan zej nak lježe' ka', san nake' Bx̱oz dan' nape' yeḻa' wak che yeḻa' nban da' batkle yeyožen.
Nyejw ḻe'e yiche la'y da' ẕzoa lin chie' Ḻe', da' ẕnnan:
Na'a, ba wdé che diža' golen' ka žaḻa' gak bx̱oz, dan' bi wdapkzen yeḻa' wak, na' bi be gok gonen.
Dan' bchi'le Moisés bi gok yeyonen dot chawe' benách ka' ḻaw Dios. Na'a, ba wyó'o to da' žx̱en ḻáže'žo da' nakžen chawe', da' žonen ga gak bíga'žo ḻaw Dios.
Katen' ben Dios ga nak Jesusen' Bx̱oz, ben choche' x̱tiže'e.
Bi ben choch Dios x̱tiže'e katen' wžíe' benne' ka' nich gákgake' bx̱oz ka', san katen' wžíe' Jesusen' nich gake' Bx̱oz, na' ben choche' x̱tiže'e, na' wnné':

content.text: Ben chocha' x̱tiža'a neda', X̱ano', wnnía':

content: Che ḻen, Benne' Criston' nake' Bennen' žone' ga nakkze dižan' da' ẕka'n chawe' dan' nakžen chawe' ka gok da' nežwn'.
Bx̱oz ka' gókgake' benne' zan, dan' bi gok gá'ngake' nga dan' gótgake',
san dan' zóateze Jesusen', to chi'ize nake' Bx̱oz, na' batkle gon byenen chaz no benne' latje chie' nich gake' bx̱oz.
Che ḻen, to chi'ize gak Jesusen' yeslé' benne' ka' ẕbíga'gake' ḻaw Dios, ni'a che la Jesusen', dan' zóateze' nbane', na' ẕnne chawe'e ḻo wlázgake' ḻaw Diosen'.
Ben byenen soa to Bx̱oz Blo ki chežo. Nake' la'y, na' dot chawe', na' bi žónḻene' benne' doḻa' ka' tẕen, san nakže' ẕen ka yógo'te da' žen' ya'abá che Dios.

Jesusen' bi nake' kan zej nak bx̱oz blo ka', benne' ka' nníta'gake' yežlyó nga, dan' ben byenen wdégake' žen ḻaw Dios tža tža. Bétgake' bia yix̱e' ka' ḻawe' Ḻe' ni'a che doḻa' da' zej nbága'kze', na' wdé na' tḻebe béngake' ni'a che doḻa' da' zej nbaga' benách ka'. Na'a, Jesusen', toze chi'i bdie' žen ḻaw Dios, katen' bde kwine' ḻaw Dios, na' bḻalje' x̱chenkze' ni'a che doḻa' da' zej nbaga' yógo'te benách ka'.

Ḻo da' bchi'le Moisés, benách ka' bi zej nake' dot chawe', zej nake' bx̱oz, san wdé bžin da' bchi'le Moisés ga ni, Dios ben choche' x̱tiže'e, na' bene' ga nak Ẕi'nkze' Bx̱oz Blo, dan' nake' dot chawe' kan žaḻa' gak to bx̱oz che Dios.
